description: This file defines template classes for plugin monitoring and interface management within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace. It includes classes for monitoring plugin activation/deactivation, managing interface pointers, and handling plugin communication, specifically for Raspberry Pi 4 64-bit architecture. It also provides classes for interacting with remote interfaces via RPC, including both plugin and controller perspectives.

classes.name: PluginMonitorType
classes.description: Template class for monitoring plugin activation and deactivation, managing interface pointers, and notifying handlers.

classes.name: RPC::SmartInterfaceType
classes.description: Template class for managing remote interface connections via RPC, handling activation/deactivation, and interface acquisition.

classes.name: RPC::PluginSmartInterfaceType
classes.description: Template class for managing plugin interfaces within a plugin context, handling activation/deactivation, and interface access.

classes.name: RPC::SmartControllerInterfaceType
classes.description: Template class for managing controller interface connections via RPC, handling activation/deactivation, and interface access.

methods.name: IsOperational
methods.description: Checks if the plugin or interface is operational.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a plugin shell or interface with the monitor.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a plugin shell or interface from the monitor.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a remote interface or plugin.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the connection to a remote interface or plugin.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a specific interface version from a remote node.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Callback for derived classes to handle operational state changes.

methods.name: Activated
methods.description: Internal callback invoked when a plugin or interface is activated.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Internal callback invoked when a plugin or interface is deactivated.

methods.name: RegisterJob
methods.description: Job class for deferred registration of plugin interfaces.
